rawContent: @michaelhogan In the US, White lives already matter, are more respected and are in positions of power to ensure White lives continue to matter. We do not see the same value placed on Black lives, hence #BlackLivesMatter. To say ‘All Lives Matter’ suggests that White lives aren’t already valued

@michaelhogan The slogan All Lives Matter, like Blue Lives Matter, has been used in the US to undercut the #BlackLivesMatter movement because it ignores the realities of particular communities where their lives have not been valued historically.
